selection_rationale.demand: 12 and 54 MWh/year are explicit illustrative occupied-space heating budgets, selected to give a small club and a larger community building different loads. They are not inferred from an unverified floor area or meter.
selection_rationale.capacity: A 40 kW hot-side package deliberately limits winter coverage. Source availability of 30 kW is at most 0.3% of the inherited 10 MW IT-heat reference; the interface and flow are teaching assumptions.
selection_rationale.temperature: 32/27 C primary recovery, 30/25 C heat-pump source, 55/45 C delivery and assumed 45/35 C building circuits make a declared heat-pump case without replacing the baseline cooling technology.
selection_rationale.losses: 90% and 85% delivery efficiency are separate explicit branch allowances; the longer hypothetical Senior Center branch is assigned the larger allowance. This is not an engineering estimate of actual pipe loss.
selection_rationale.seasonality: Monthly percentages sum to 100 and are an authored seasonal shape, not a weather-derived SF heating forecast.
selection_rationale.pumps: 0.15 kW common circulation, 0.05 kW controls, 0.10/0.15 kW branch pumps are selected inventories outside compressor-only COP, charged only during active windows; off-window energy is assumed zero.
